g.text: A0: fixed pretrained baseline (no seed SD). B0–D1: mean ± sample SD over seeds 123 / 456 / 789.
Same 9,600 training / 1,200 validation images; 8 epochs; frozen backbone + original pose head.
Aligned: decoded relative translation + rotation chordal loss. Split: crop-space xy/z L1 + same rotation loss.
D1: supplementary control, excluded from the already-locked main model selection.
D0 exactly matches B0: LR × WD = 5e-9 rounds away in FP32; this is not evidence that WD never matters.
Curves show actual epoch metrics, not running minima. This is not a Token-count parameter sweep.
Small differences are exploratory; inherited baseline training coverage is unknown.
(c) Validation ablation: best checkpoint per seed
